san_agustin_reference.document_context: Anexo N°5, ficha técnica 001: servicio de protección en la ribera de la quebrada San Agustín vulnerable ante inundación en el Anexo de María
san_agustin_reference.reported_hazard_context: lluvias intensas, huaicos e inundaciones asociadas al bloqueo del cauce por relaves mineros

scientific_interpretation.reason_no_geometry: The source gives endpoints of a proposed/protection reach, not a surveyed full channel centerline, catchment boundary, outlet, event footprint or faja geometry. Connecting those endpoints would invent an unreported channel alignment.

candidate_implication.next_safe_geometry_need: machine-readable or coordinate-complete official quebrada/faja/channel geometry that identifies San Agustín reproducibly, plus independent evidence before any routing relation to Río Acarí is asserted

forbidden_uses: draw a straight channel line between the two protection-reach endpoints
treat the protection reach as a complete quebrada geometry
treat the protection reach as an event footprint or inundation footprint
infer historical hydraulic capacity from a protection project
infer a hydrologic connection to Río Acarí from shared provincial or administrative context
derive a negative control from documentary silence
derive operational thresholds, risk levels or alerts
